page.overview:
Who is Dr. Inferno?

Dr. Inferno is an Agents minifigure introduced in 2008.

Dr. Inferno wears a white labcoat with printed orange lapels and belts as well as his insignia on his chest and on his back. He wears a black glove on his left hand. His right arm is a cool silver, drum lacquered robotic arm with a silver (in 2008) or cool silver, drum lacquered (in 2009) Stick Ø 3.2 W. Holder claw. His hair is Evil Wig 'No.1', which is black with bright orange highlights. His face is printed with arched eyebrows, a wide manic grin, and a scar over his white left eye.

Dr. Inferno is the main antagonist of the Agents theme and has been one of the LEGO Agents' most wanted villains since their formation. He is an evil genius who tries to take over the world with his crazy schemes to sow chaos with his technology, weaponry, and henchmen. His evil lair is the Volcano Base. He is old friends with Dr. D. Zaster.

In Mission 6, after Dr. Inferno's laptop was stolen by Agents, Dr. Inferno is cornered and captured by the Agents and held prisoner on their Mobile Command Center, but he breaks free with the help of his henchmen Gold Tooth and Spy Clops. In Mission 8, Dr. Inferno prepares to fire the laser atop his Volcano Base, but the Agents arrive to thwart his plans.
